title: Says (8) and (9) right despite a scrambled screen text
idealItem: What it is: a robot scientist + Done-feel 2 (wrong equation numbers)
chapter: Meeting 3: Understanding the results and observations (parts 2 and 3)
asked: Could you give me the formulas for equations eight and nine? || Just to be clear, are you saying it's sine squared theta in equation eight, or sine of two theta?
answer: y of x equals x tangent theta minus g x squared over 2 v zero squared cosine squared theta. That's a parabola through the origin, marked as equation 6. Sure. Equation 8 is v zero squared sine 2 theta over 2g. Equation 9 is the identity, sine 2 theta equals 2 sine theta cosine theta. Sine of 2 theta in equation 8.
why: It wrongly gives (8) as sin 2θ, calls (9) only the identity, and confirms the opposite of the required sine-squared clarification.
